q.t: A cube has volume p³ + 6p²q + 12pq² + 8q³. What is its side?
q.e: It is p³ + 3p²(2q) + 3p(2q)² + (2q)³ = (p + 2q)³.

q.t: (x − 2) and (x − ½) are factors of px² + 5x + r. What must be true?
q.e: px² + 5x + r = p(x − 2)(x − ½) = px² − (5p/2)x + p, so the constant r = p.
